verdict.rationale: A runtime probe checked against the official docs reports that Godot ships a built-in GDScript language server (LSP) that external editors or agent tooling can attach to. It also names godotengine/godot-vscode-plugin, an actively maintained repo in the official org, as the first-party LSP client, and the docs separately confirm support for external editors such as VS Code. Missing for 10: no direct first-party doc excerpt detailing completions, diagnostics and navigation features; no evidence of comparable tooling for C#; no independent hands-on corroboration of the LSP's quality.
